kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
wire.summary: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

wire.title: Casualties continue to rise after Brooklyn building collapses
wire.summary: First responders continue to search for survivors after a building in Brooklyn collapsed, leaving at least eight dead and dozens injured.

wire.title: Democrats want to stop Trump's arch, golf course and more. What are their options?
wire.summary: As Trump's arch and other projects make their way through the courts, many critics are looking to Congress to stop them. Democrats have a few tools, including funding and oversight.

wire.title: The SS United States takes its final voyage to the bottom of the Gulf of Mexico
wire.summary: A ship bigger than the Titanic is being sunk off the coast of Florida to make an artificial reef.

wire.title: Witnesses describe the D.C. shooting that left 1 dead, 4 injured
wire.summary: A gunman opened fire at a gym in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle Thursday morning. One person has been confirmed killed and four others injured. The gunman is dead, according to police.

wire.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in the Kremlin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
wire.summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff went to the Kremlin to brief Russian President Vladimir Putin and are scheduled to fly later to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

wire.title: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
wire.summary: Raka is the son of former President Joko Widodo. The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents that Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.

wire.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
wire.summary: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

wire.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
wire.summary: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.

wire.title: At least 23 states considered laws governing ICE and schools this year
wire.summary: When ICE agents show up at a school, educators rely on a patchwork of policies to know what to do. This year, many state legislatures tried to update those policies.

wire.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
wire.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.

wire.title: 'We've got to run': Inside ruined Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat
wire.summary: Dan Johnson visits one of the country's largest power stations, barely left standing after a ballistic missile strike by Russia.

wire.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
wire.summary: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.

wire.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
wire.summary: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

wire.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
wire.summary: Specialist Thomas Iglesias was given a Joint Service Commendation Medal for the execution of his duties after Wednesday's incident.

wire.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
wire.summary: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
